otel.serviceNameDesc: If kept empty, the service name will be set to "bifrost"
otel.protocolDesc: Transport used for both trace and metrics export.
otel.commonHeadersDesc: Sent to both the trace and metrics endpoints.
otel.insecureDesc: Skip TLS verification. Disable this to use TLS with system root CAs or a custom CA certificate.
otel.tlsCaPathDesc: File path to the CA certificate on the Bifrost server. Leave empty to use system root CAs.
otel.enableTraceExportDesc: Export spans to the OTLP collector. Turn off for a metrics-only profile.
otel.traceHeadersDesc: Sent only to the trace endpoint, in addition to the common headers.
otel.exportTimeoutDesc: Maximum time for a single trace export (1-60 seconds). Traces are dropped rather than retried past this limit, so an unreachable collector cannot slow down request handling.
otel.requestHeadersDesc: Comma-separated list of request headers to capture and emit as span attributes. Supports exact names and wildcard patterns (e.g. x-custom-* captures all headers with that prefix, * captures all headers; note that * will capture sensitive headers like Authorization).
otel.disableContentLoggingDesc: When enabled, message content (input/output messages, tool definitions, and tool call arguments/results) is dropped from exported spans. Only metadata such as model, tokens, and latency is sent to the collector.
otel.exportRawPayloadsDesc: Attach the raw provider request and response bodies to exported spans. Requires raw request/response storage to be enabled on the provider.
otel.groupTracesBySessionDesc: When enabled, requests sharing the same x-bf-session-id header are grouped into a single trace, each request appearing as a top-level sibling span. A request carrying an inbound W3C traceparent stays on its own distributed trace and is unaffected.
otel.disableRootSpanContentDesc: When enabled, input/output message content is dropped from the root span only; the underlying generation (llm.call) span keeps the full content.
otel.enableMetricsExportDesc: Push metrics to an OTEL Collector for proper aggregation in cluster deployments
otel.overheadBreakdownDesc: Export per-component Bifrost overhead latency as a histogram.
otel.metricsHeadersDesc: Sent only to the metrics endpoint, in addition to the common headers (e.g. a Databricks table name).
otel.pushIntervalDesc: How often to push metrics (1-300 seconds)

prom.userLabelsDesc: Add user data labels to metrics
prom.pullScrapingDesc: Prometheus can scrape metrics from the /metrics endpoint
prom.pullEndpointNote: Configure your Prometheus server to scrape this endpoint. Served only while Pull-based scraping is enabled.
prom.pushGatewayDesc: Push metrics to a Prometheus Push Gateway for proper aggregation in cluster deployments
prom.multiNodeNote: If you are running multiple Bifrost nodes, use push gateway for accurate metrics. Pull-based /metrics scraping may miss nodes behind a load balancer.
prom.pushGatewayUrlDesc: URL of your Prometheus Push Gateway
prom.instanceIdDesc: Used to identify this Bifrost instance in metrics. If not set, hostname is used automatically.
prom.exposeNote: Expose Bifrost metrics for Prometheus to scrape from the /metrics endpoint, or push them to a Prometheus Push Gateway.

maxim.requestHeadersDesc: Comma-separated list of request headers to capture and attach as trace tags. Supports exact names and wildcard patterns (e.g. x-custom-* captures all headers with that prefix, * captures all headers; note that * will capture sensitive headers like Authorization).
maxim.repoHeaderNote: You can send in header x-bf-log-repo-id with a repository ID to log to a specific repository.
